products.name: DeLaurenti Rosato 750ml
products.description: A new batch of DeLaurenti Rosato has made it to our shelves! This rose is reminiscent of the roses of Provence, despite being entirely Tuscan Sangiovese. Refreshing, dry, and light with a slightly tart berry finish. This wine will transport you to a sunny afternoon on a breezy Mediterranean beach, no matter what time of year you pop the cork!

products.name: Arnot-Roberts Rosé
products.description: Despite its location, Arnot-Roberts make wines that have a decidedly European edge to them. This rosé of Touriga Nacional has some familiar aromatics if you're a fan of Port, but that's about where the similarities end. Dry, a little prickly, and incredibly refreshing.

products.name: Can-Vi Rosat
products.description: This refreshing and dry rosé of Monestrell (the Spanish name for Mourvedre) is made entirely of young vine, organic fruit. A lively, textural rosé that, despite its darker color, is quite light on the palate. Plus, the can makes for easy enjoyment out in the wild!

products.name: Can-Vi Sparkling Rosat
products.description: This sparkling rosé of Monestrell comes from one of our favorite Catalonian winemakers, Jordi Llorens. Delicious, well-farmed fruit, in a wine that finishes its fermentation in can, and delivers a pét-nat with fine and lively bubbles!

products.name: Cedergreen 'Viola' Rosé
products.tagline: Columbia Valley, WA - Cabernet Franc, Gamay - 2025
products.description: If you've shopped or eaten at the market anytime in last decade or two, you've probably enjoyed a glass or three of Cedergreen's rosé. This lighter blend of Cab Franc and Gamay has some gorgeous floral and fruity aromatics and a crisp, dry finish.

products.name: Chateau Jouclary Cabardes Rose
products.description: Rose from Southern France is sometimes a gamble but rest assured that we're doing the hard work of tasting through all available options and only bring you the best. Through all this "hard work" we were really impressed with the rose from Chateau de Jouclary this year! Classic tart berry on the nose, crispy and dry finish, but a unique salty/savory note on the palate that just begs to be paired with fresh veggies and creamy cheeses.

products.name: La Bastide des Oliviers Rosé
products.tagline: Provence, FR - Cinsault, Carignan, Grenache, Syrah - 2025
products.description: A light, pure, and refreshing Provençal rosé is hard to beat when the sun starts hanging around extra late in the day. La Bastide des Oliviers makes one of our favorites because it's exactly what you want it to be at a pretty darn great price, too.

products.name: Le Vigne di Faraone Cerasuolo d'Abruzzo DOC
products.description: Cerasuolo d'Abruzzo is an appellation for rose of Montepulciano in a Abruzzo. The word Cerasuolo designates the cherry color of the wines. It's darker than most rose, slightly more rich, but still finishes dry with some refreshing acidity.

products.name: Marcel Giraudon Bourgogne Rosé
products.description: While we don't always associate rosé when it comes to wine from Bourgogne, it is a rare and rewarding treat to come across such bottlings, and this one is no different. If you're patient with it, and don't mind cellaring this wine for a few years, you'll be highly rewarded. But if you can't wait - and to be honest, who could blame you? - this wine is a stunner with fresh garden produce, bistro classics, and the bounty of PNW seafood.

products.name: Mary Taylor Agenais Rose
products.tagline: Lot-et-Garonne, FR - 2022 - Cabernet Sauvingon, Cabernet Franc - 2022
products.description: This rose comes from this no-man's land between Bordeaux and the Languedoc, historically a wine region only known for bulk grocery store wine. However, this is a small, organic production brought in via Mary Taylor Wines, and displays not only tremendous value, but expectional flavor. A vibrant, light-cherry color in the glass that's reminiscent of Tavel, this rose is refreshing and textural, and great with seafood and lighter proteins.

products.name: Ostatu Rioja Rosado
products.description: Bodegas Ostatu is easily one of the best houses operating in Rioja Alavesa. This rosé isn't just some passable pink to get you through the summer, this is a real wine of character. Mostly Tempranillo and Garnacha, there's also a splash of the white grape Viura in here; the combination of all three pointing to a true, albeit light, expression of this corner of the country. Brimming with red fruit and citrus peel, this dry rosé is great all year, but especially on a sweltering summer afternoon down by the water.

products.name: Pinard et Filles 'Verre de Gris' Rose
products.description: While one may not always associate Quebec and rosé, this one is sure to leave an impression. A tense and nervous expression of Frontenac Gris, this wine shines with rustic cured meats or anything off the grill.

products.name: Poberaj Ramato
products.description:
100 days whole cluster skin contact in 10HL open top wood cask.

Pressed into a neutral French barrel and aged for 3 years.

products.name: Ridge of Wonders Rosé of Pinot Noir
products.description: High-Altitude Pinot Noir from the Washington side of the Columbia River Gorge make for an ethereal, aromatic rosé that doesn't feel reminiscent of any other more-storied rosé-producing region, but fits nicely in a lineup of all the Mediterranean classics. There's a delicate salinity to this wine as well that makes it especially friendly with shellfish and summer produce, too.
